frame: meta is ONE converging system. prompt-hub = the merged prompt_hub#182 two-layer Front-Door: harness_hub is the intent INTERPRETER (user intent -> model-ready language), prompt_hub is the durable intent STORE + boundary (ADR-0007). The store emits provenance-stamped goal artifacts that rusty-idd CONSUMES; prompt_hub never owns rusty-idd's lifecycle (owner decision D3, reply #178). handoff (+) rusty-idd union (D1) is the continuity+intent control plane; weave = transport; grit = symbol-level coordination substrate; north-star @ META_ROOT + handoff.
id_convention: kebab-case ids ONLY. Fleet repos use snake_case (prompt_hub, harness_hub, meta-ruvector); standardized to kebab-case here: prompt_hub->prompt-hub, harness_hub->harness-hub, meta-ruvector->ruvector.

nodes.spec: Front-Door intent STORE + boundary (merged prompt_hub#182, ADR-0007). Durable, provenance-stamped goal-artifact store; emits goal artifacts that rusty-idd consumes. Substrate-ish root for this run; the harness_hub interpreter is an upstream SEAM (soft) but the store is planned independently (D3).

seams.note: harness_hub interprets intent -> model-ready language ahead of the store; soft seam, prompt-hub planned independently (D3)
prompt-hub model lanes served by shimmy; soft seam, not a blocking dep

nodes.spec: Intent-driven development tool. CONSUMES prompt-hub's goal artifacts (ADR-0007) and owns the OpenSpec/ADR/task/validation/manifest/PR flow. Union target: its cli/core/runner/spec/tui crates dedup-merge into handoff via grit coordination.

Continuity ledger kernel (hf). Union target + dedup destination; renders packets from the witnessed ledger. Consumes grit (symbol coordination), weave (transport heartbeat), icm (persistent memory), and the rusty-idd union crates.
A2A transport / observable heartbeat for the loop. Carries relay broadcasts over the lane spine.

Symbol-level merge/lock coordination substrate. Coordinates union step 2 (dedup of the ~95% shared handoff<->rusty-idd crates: cli/core/runner/spec/tui). Per reply #178: advisory symbol-LOCK + git-worktree coordinator around a separate reconciler, not the reconciler itself. Substrate root.

Front-Door intent INTERPRETER: transforms user intent -> model-ready language ahead of the prompt-hub store (two-layer front door, D3). Catalog/registry that routes harnesses; runs atop the continuity kernel + transport. (fleet id: harness_hub; kebab-cased here.)
Infinite Context Memory: persistent cross-session recall/store substrate; uses vector embeddings from ruvector.
Agentic environment manager: installs every tool/dep into meta (.toolchains), no system-global installs. Substrate root (loop run-from host).
Network/transport spine substrate. Provides the channel weave and the network-control plane compose over. Substrate root.
Local model server substrate (local inference lane). Serves prompt-hub model lanes via a soft seam. Substrate root.
Vector compute / code-intelligence substrate (fleet path: meta-ruvector). Backs icm embeddings and graph intelligence. Substrate root.

self_revision.trigger: verifier-qualified: prompt-hub role corrected (cycle 6 vs prior cycles)
self_revision.action: Prior cycles modeled prompt-hub as a prompt/model registry feeding harness-hub (edge prompt-hub -> harness-hub, see plan-grit DAG). The verified ADR-0007 + owner decision D3 / reply #178 reframe it as the intent STORE feeding rusty-idd: (1) ADDED hard edge prompt-hub -> rusty-idd and rusty-idd now lists prompt-hub as an upstream dep; (2) the old prompt-hub -> harness-hub edge is RETIRED and replaced by a SOFT interpreter seam harness-hub ⇢ prompt-hub (direction flipped). Localized: only rusty-idd and harness-hub specs revised; grit/handoff/weave/icm/lane/shimmy/ruvector/envctl preserved.

self_revision.trigger: prompt-hub verifier outcome on the ADR-0007 emit contract (goal-artifact schema + provenance stamping)
self_revision.action: If prompt-hub's verifier QUALIFIES or REFUTES the goal-artifact emit contract, revise ONLY rusty-idd's consume spec (the downstream consumer); preserve all other nodes. Do not touch the union (rusty-idd -> handoff) dedup spec unless the contract change cascades there.

self_revision.trigger: harness_hub interpreter seam verified as a HARD prerequisite
self_revision.action: If a verifier finds the harness_hub interpreter is a hard prerequisite (intent must be interpreted before the store can be specified), PROMOTE the soft seam harness-hub ⇢ prompt-hub to a hard dep (prompt-hub.deps += harness-hub), which removes prompt-hub from the ready-set and re-runs the topological order. Currently held as SOFT per owner decision D3 (planned independently).
